summary: BTQ Technologies Corp. filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, announcing the appointment of Dr. Michael Grace, former Samsung Knox security leader, to its U.S. team. Grace will support product security and commercialization of the QCIM architecture for post-quantum cryptography. This is a routine personnel addition, not an abrupt departure or forced change. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report with no special-situation terms, deal structure, or financial details. The appointment is voluntary, strategic, and lacks the characteristics of a disruptive management event.
